description:
Move the predecessor repository-materialization showcase deck into the feature archive and leave a tombstone at its original path pointing to the corrected successor deck and to the audit.

## Background

The predecessor showcase deck lives at `dev/presentations/cdc840ad/` (`talk.html`, `base.css`, and a `themes/` directory). An adversarial audit found nine falsifiable errors in it, and a corrected successor deck now lives at `dev/presentations/1cc809de/`. The predecessor must be retired without breaking existing links to its location: the deck files move to the established feature-archive shape `dev/archive/features/cdc840ad/showcase/`, and a tombstone document takes their place at the original directory so any reader or link arriving there is redirected to the corrected successor and the audit that motivated the succession.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The predecessor deck files (`talk.html`, `base.css`, and the `themes/` directory) are relocated from `dev/presentations/cdc840ad/` to `dev/archive/features/cdc840ad/showcase/` with their contents unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: A tombstone document remains at `dev/presentations/cdc840ad/` that links to the successor deck at `dev/presentations/1cc809de/` and to the audit at `dev/studies/cdc840ad-audit-2026-07-23.md`, and states that the deck it replaced was retired for containing falsifiable claims.
- [hard] REQ-03: The tombstone occupies the original deck directory path so that prior references to `dev/presentations/cdc840ad/` resolve to it, and every link in the tombstone resolves to an existing repository path.

## Notes

The archive destination `dev/archive/features/cdc840ad/showcase/` follows the established feature-archive shape under `dev/archive/features/`. The tombstone is the sole content remaining at the original path.
title: Archive the predecessor deck behind a tombstone
